description: Loosely: an early-game cluster on the left-centre of the bottom row: column 0 and column 4 empty while columns 1, 2 and 3 each hold a stone, strongest when (0,1) is theirs and (0,2) is mine. Column 0 stacked me/them/me/them from the bottom also drives it hard. Very context-sensitive; a filled column 0 (non-alternating) or column 4 suppresses it.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to zero or to max shifts move probabilities by at most about 0.03.
notes: Best dev F1 0.374 (p4: col0 & col4 empty, cols 1-3 occupied); submitted p6 F1 0.372, AUROC 0.69, simulation share 0.13. Cell-pair rules ((0,1) theirs/(0,2) mine) F1 0.12-0.28. Minimal pairs show strong dependence on distant filler stones and mover parity, so the unit looks distributed (possibly a random direction). Steer effect negligible. Synthesis 3,0,1,2,0,0,0 reaches 5.57 > dev max 5.40.
